content.json:
## Telemetry
The services and the browser (through the API's /api/otel relay) export here. Ingestion takes 1-5 minutes, sometimes over 10.

### Transactions
One row per operation. hasBrowser: a span relayed from the page. hasRequest: an API request. hasDb: a database dependency (never on SQLite). Select a row to see its items in order.

content.query:
union requests, dependencies
| summarize start = min(timestamp),
    request = take_anyif(name, itemType == "request"),
    role = take_anyif(cloud_RoleName, itemType == "request"),
    hasBrowser = countif(tostring(customDimensions["relay.source"]) == "browser") > 0,
    hasRequest = countif(itemType == "request") > 0,
    hasDb = countif(itemType == "dependency" and type in~ ("postgresql", "SQL")) > 0,
    durationMs = max(duration),
    failed = countif(success == false) > 0,
    items = count()
    by operation_Id
| order by start desc
| take 100

union requests, dependencies, traces, exceptions
| where operation_Id == "{OperationId}"
| project timestamp, itemType, cloud_RoleName, name, type, target, duration, success,
          relayed = tostring(customDimensions["relay.source"]), message
| order by timestamp asc

requests
| where success == false
| summarize failures = count(), last = max(timestamp) by cloud_RoleName, operation_Name, resultCode
| order by failures desc
content.title: Failed requests

content.query:
exceptions
| summarize count = count(), last = max(timestamp), sample = take_any(outerMessage) by cloud_RoleName, type
| order by count desc
content.title: Exceptions

content.json:
### Dependencies
Database and HTTP calls by target, slowest p95 first.

content.query:
dependencies
| summarize calls = count(), failures = countif(success == false),
    p50Ms = percentile(duration, 50), p95Ms = percentile(duration, 95)
    by cloud_RoleName, type, target
| order by p95Ms desc

content.json:
### Browser logs
Logs the page sent through the relay, newest first.

content.query:
traces
| where tostring(customDimensions["CategoryName"]) == "Browser"
| project timestamp, severityLevel, message, operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
| take 200
